name: @pipeworx/mcp-connecticut-code

tools.name: ct_general_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Connecticut General Statutes — Connecticut state law — by citation. "Conn. Gen. Stat. 53a-54a" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Connecticut General Statutes 53a-54a say" or to check a CT statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "53a-54a" (murder) or "14-227a" (DUI). The part before the dash is the title.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-connecticut-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the connecticut-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
